name: 视频反射一致性
description: 检测视频帧中表面和眼睛反射的不一致性。
useCase: Identifying 深度伪造s through 反射 异常 in eyes, glasses, and reflective surfaces
mechanism: 分析 specular highlights and 反射s in eyes, glasses, and other reflective surfaces for consistency with the environment. AI生成的 videos frequently produce incorrect corneal 反射s, mismatched specular highlights, or physically impossible 反射 模式.
accuracy: Medium-高 - 75-88% on face-focused 深度伪造s
source: Hu, S. et al. (2021) - Exposing GAN-generated Faces Using Inconsistent Corneal Specular Highlights, ICASSP
algorithm: Corneal Reflection Detection + Specular Highlight Tracking + Cross-Frame Consistency
parameters: Eye 检测: landmark-based, Reflection extraction: 阈值ing + clustering, Consistency: 相关性
strengths:
• 检测物理上不可能的反射
• 发现环境映射不一致
• AI生成难以维持反射一致性
• 与光照分析高度互补
limitations:
• 反射面少的场景效果有限
• 复杂反射环境分析困难
• 计算成本高
• 低分辨率下反射细节不足

references.title: Hu, S. et al. (2021). Exposing GAN-generated Faces Using Inconsistent Corneal Specular Highlights. ICASSP.
Guo, X. et al. (2022). Eyes Tell All: Detecting Political Orientation from Eye Movement Data. AAAI.
Matern, F. et al. (2019). Exploiting Visual Artifacts to Expose Deepfakes. WACV.
